paper.title_en: Quasinormal modes of thick branes in $f(R,T)$ gravity
paper.abstract_en: We study tensor perturbations and quasinormal modes (QNMs) of thick branes in $f(R,T)=R+αT$ gravity. Starting from the background thick brane solutions, we derive the Schrödinger-like equation for gravitational perturbations and construct the corresponding effective potential. The effective potential exhibits a double-barrier structure whose properties depend on the model parameters. We analyze transmission spectra and find good agreement between resonance peaks and the real parts of the quasinormal frequencies. The parameters $b$ and $α$ mainly control the width and height of the potential barriers, respectively. QNMs are extracted using both time-domain evolution and direct integration methods, showing consistent results for low-lying modes. Higher overtones become increasingly difficult to extract due to stronger damping and numerical contamination. Our results indicate that $f(R,T)$ corrections significantly affect both the effective potential and the quasinormal spectrum, providing a possible imprint of modified gravity in braneworld perturbations.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 研究$f(R,T)=R+αT$引力下厚膜的张量扰动与准正规模，推导了类似薛定谔方程并给出双势垒有效势，同时使用时域演化和直接积分两种方法交叉验证低阶模，并讨论模型参数对势垒与谱的影响；属于修改引力与引力扰动/准正规模交叉的理论工作，具备明确的物理动机和可复现的方法描述，值得进一步阅读。
decision.abstract_zh: 我们研究了$f(R,T)=R+αT$引力中厚膜的张量扰动与准正规模（QNMs）。从背景厚膜解出发，我们推导了引力扰动的类薛定谔方程，并构造了相应的有效势。该有效势呈现出双势垒结构，其性质依赖于模型参数。我们分析了透射谱，发现共振峰与准正规模频率的实部之间具有良好的一致性。参数$b$和$α$分别主要控制势垒的宽度和高度。我们同时使用时域演化和直接积分方法提取QNMs，对低阶模给出了相互一致的结果。由于更强的阻尼和数值污染，高阶泛音变得越来越难以提取。我们的结果表明，$f(R,T)$修正显著影响有效势和准正规模谱，这为修改引力在膜世界扰动中提供了可能的印记。
